label: HPE ProLiant ML350 Gen11 4U tower server
description: 4U two-socket tower server with no embedded LOM: the default configuration carries a Broadcom BCM5719 1Gb 4-port BASE-T OCP 3.0 adapter plus a dedicated 1GbE iLO 6 management port, and a second OCP 3.0 slot plus up to 10 PCIe 5.0 slots stay free for faster NICs.
